paras: Transform your Audi 8Y or 8V sedan—with the latest XFORCE VAREX cat-back exhaust system. Designed to match the power and prestige of the S3, this system delivers a refined balance of everyday comfort and aggressive performance sound, all at your command.

Crafted from high-grade 304 stainless steel , the system features mandrel-bent 3” piping , a drone canister , and a VAREX valved rear muffler —allowing drivers to seamlessly switch between a quiet, near-stock tone and a bold, sport-inspired growl. Whether you're heading to work or hitting your favorite back road, the XFORCE system adapts to your drive.
hl: Drone canister tube for reduced cabin drone
VAREX valved rear muffler with remote fob for sound control
Quad 4” double-wall tips for a bold look
Direct bolt-on installation with all hardware included
ft: XForce AUDI S3 8Y and 8V Sedan Varex Valved Cat Back Exhaust System
